basic.name: Spin To Win!
basic.description: Activate to have each Viking deal 85~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

basic.name: Norse Force!
basic.description: All Vikings gain a 140~~0.04~~ to 308~~0.04~~ point Shield, increasing in strength for each Viking alive. Lasts 4 seconds.

basic.name: Jump!
basic.description: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

basic.name: Nordic Attack Squad
basic.description: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other two Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

basic.name: Viking Bribery
basic.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

basic.name: Mortar
basic.description: Fires a mortar at the targeted location, dealing 228~~0.04~~ damage in a large area.

heroic.name: Longboat Raid!
heroic.description:
Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128~~0.04~~ damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228~~0.04~~ damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.

Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

heroic.name: Play Again!
heroic.description:
Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. 

Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

trait.name: Viking Hoard
trait.description:
Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.

Current Bonus: 0 Regen per second

mount.name: Go Go Go!
mount.description: The Vikings gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Select Olaf
activable.description:
Olaf can charge enemies and slow their Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds by right-clicking on them. 8 second cooldown. 

Olaf gains increased Health Regeneration when out of combat for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Select Baleog
activable.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks deal 50% damage to enemies behind his attack target.

activable.name: Select Erik
activable.description: Erik moves faster than the other Vikings and has increased Basic Attack range.

activable.name: Select All Vikings
activable.description: The Lost Vikings can be controlled individually or as a group. Each Viking has particular strengths.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: Teleports you back to the Altar, instantly restoring you to full Health.

level1.name: Olaf the Stout
level1.description:
Passive: Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health.

Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level1.name: Spy Games
level1.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

level1.name: Explosive Attacks
level1.description: Baleog's Basic Attack splash damage against non-Heroes is no longer reduced by 50%.

level1.name: Viking Bribery
level1.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

level4.name: Pain Don't Hurt
level4.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

level4.name: Erik the Swift
level4.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34~~0.04~~ Health per second.

level4.name: It's a Sabotage!
level4.description: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225~~0.04~~ damage.

level4.name: Mercenary Lord
level4.description: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

level7.name: Baleog the Fierce
level7.description: Increase Baleog's attack range by 2.5. While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

level16.name: Large and In Charge
level16.description: When Olaf charges enemies, they are stunned for 1 second.

level16.name: Impatience Is a Virtue
level16.description: Enemies damaged by a Viking's Basic Attack reduce the cooldown of all Viking Abilities by 0.3125 seconds.

level16.name: 64 KB Marathon
level16.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

level16.name: Executioner
level16.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Ragnarok 'n' Roll!
level20.description: The Longboat can attack two targets at once and the range of its Mortar is increased by 100%. Reduce Longboat Raid!'s cooldown by 30 seconds.

level20.name: Checkpoint Reached
level20.description: 10 seconds after using Play Again!, any dead Vikings are revived and summoned again, and all are healed to full.

level20.name: The Sequel!
level20.description: Reduces the Lost Vikings's death timer by 50%.

level20.name: Fury of the Storm
level20.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 41~~0.04~~ damage to the target, and 105~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters. Each Viking has their own cooldown.
